title: Container Report - Week 42
summary:
Container
Container freight markets were broadly stable over the week, with the FBX Weighted Average rising from 3,370 at the start of the week to 3,560 by the end of the week. The most significant movement was seen on the Asia to US East Coast trade, where rates rose from $9,606 to $10,772/FEU over the week. This rise accounted for most of the increase in the composite index and remains the standout development across the major east-west trades this week.
